'''Oora Gellandi''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] who lived on the planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], during the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Her [[Lethorn/Legends|lethorns]] were covered with inlaid rings of various metals and stones, accenting her blue skin.

At the age of sixteen, she joined the small gang, led by [[Naja Delan]], based on their desire to start a sect of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. She believed that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were better than other beings because of their connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], although there are no records indicating she herself was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]].

The group found itself in trouble, just after the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when Delan stumbled upon the plot to assassinate [[Gavid Lermyn]].
